title: Brakeman Configuration
markdownDescription:
Configuration for Brakeman, a static analysis security scanner for Rails applications. Typically located at `config/brakeman.yml`. Generate one from command-line options with `brakeman -C`.

Command-line options take priority over the config file.

[Brakeman Documentation](https://brakemanscanner.org/docs/)

anyOf.markdownDescription: A custom check class name (for checks loaded with `additional_checks_path`).

parallel_checks.markdownDescription:
Run checks and file parsing in parallel. Set to `false` to run sequentially.

**CLI:** `-n, --no-threads`

exit_on_warn.markdownDescription:
Exit with a non-zero code when warnings are found.

**CLI:** `-z, --[no-]exit-on-warn`

exit_on_error.markdownDescription:
Exit with a non-zero code when errors are raised.

**CLI:** `--[no-]exit-on-error`

ensure_latest.markdownDescription:
Fail when Brakeman is not the latest version. Set to `true`, or to a number of days (1-15) a newer release must have been out before failing.

**CLI:** `--ensure-latest [DAYS]`

**Example:**
```yaml
ensure_latest: 7
```

ensure_ignore_notes.markdownDescription:
Fail when an ignored warning in the ignore file has no note.

**CLI:** `--ensure-ignore-notes`

ensure_no_obsolete_ignore_entries.markdownDescription:
Fail when the ignore file contains an entry that no longer matches a warning.

**CLI:** `--ensure-no-obsolete-ignore-entries`

rails4.markdownDescription:
Force Rails 4 mode. The CLI flag also sets `rails3`, so set every lower version to `true` as well.

**CLI:** `-4, --rails4`

rails5.markdownDescription:
Force Rails 5 mode. The CLI flag also sets `rails3` and `rails4`, so set every lower version to `true` as well.

**CLI:** `-5, --rails5`

rails6.markdownDescription:
Force Rails 6 mode. The CLI flag also sets `rails3` to `rails5`, so set every lower version to `true` as well.

**CLI:** `-6, --rails6`

rails7.markdownDescription:
Force Rails 7 mode. The CLI flag also sets `rails3` to `rails6`, so set every lower version to `true` as well.

**CLI:** `-7, --rails7`

rails8.markdownDescription:
Force Rails 8 mode. The CLI flag also sets `rails3` to `rails7`, so set every lower version to `true` as well.

**CLI:** `-8, --rails8`

force_scan.markdownDescription:
Scan the application even if Rails is not detected.

**CLI:** `--force-scan`

run_all_checks.markdownDescription:
Run all default and optional checks.

**CLI:** `-A, --run-all-checks`

assume_all_routes.markdownDescription:
Assume all controller methods are actions.

**CLI:** `-a, --[no-]assume-routes`

escape_html.markdownDescription:
Assume HTML is escaped by default.

**CLI:** `-e, --escape-html`

ignore_ifs.markdownDescription:
Disable flow sensitivity on conditionals. Faster, but less accurate. `--faster` sets this and `disable_constant_tracking`.

**CLI:** `--no-branching`

disable_constant_tracking.markdownDescription:
Disable tracking of constant values. Faster, but less accurate. `--faster` sets this and `ignore_ifs`.

**CLI:** `--faster`

interprocedural.markdownDescription:
Process method calls to known methods.

**CLI:** `--interprocedural`

branch_limit.markdownDescription:
Limit the depth of values in branches. Use `-1` for no limit.

**CLI:** `--branch-limit LIMIT`

parser_timeout.markdownDescription:
Seconds to spend parsing a single file before giving up.

**CLI:** `--parser-timeout SECONDS`

use_prism.markdownDescription:
Use the Prism parser (requires `prism` 1.0.0 or newer).

**CLI:** `--[no-]prism`

check_arguments.markdownDescription:
Report indirect use of untrusted data, such as arguments to methods. Set to `false` to only report direct use.

**CLI:** `-r, --report-direct`

safe_methods.markdownDescription:
Methods considered safe for unescaped output in views.

Values must be written as Ruby symbols (with a leading colon), as Brakeman compares them against symbols. Plain strings are silently ignored.

**CLI:** `-s, --safe-methods meth1,meth2`

**Example:**
```yaml
safe_methods:
  - :sanitize_markdown
```

items.markdownDescription: A method name written as a Ruby symbol, e.g. `:my_helper`.

sql_safe_methods.markdownDescription:
Do not warn about SQL injection when input is wrapped in one of these methods.

Values must be written as Ruby symbols (with a leading colon), as Brakeman compares them against symbols. Plain strings are silently ignored.

**CLI:** `--sql-safe-methods meth1,meth2`

**Example:**
```yaml
sql_safe_methods:
  - :quote_identifier
```

items.markdownDescription: A method name written as a Ruby symbol, e.g. `:my_helper`.

url_safe_methods.markdownDescription:
Do not warn about XSS when a `link_to` href is wrapped in one of these methods.

Values must be written as Ruby symbols (with a leading colon), as Brakeman compares them against symbols. Plain strings are silently ignored.

**CLI:** `--url-safe-methods meth1,meth2`

**Example:**
```yaml
url_safe_methods:
  - :safe_url
```

items.markdownDescription: A method name written as a Ruby symbol, e.g. `:my_helper`.

skip_files.markdownDescription:
Files or directories to skip. Paths are relative to the application root, and directories must end in `/`.

**CLI:** `--skip-files file1,path2`

**Example:**
```yaml
skip_files:
  - plugins/
  - app/views/legacy/report.html.erb
```

only_files.markdownDescription:
Process only these files or directories. Paths are relative to the application root, and directories must end in `/`.

**CLI:** `--only-files file1,path2`

**Example:**
```yaml
only_files:
  - app/controllers/
```

additional_libs_path.markdownDescription:
Application-relative lib directories to process.

**CLI:** `--add-libs-path path1,path2`

**Example:**
```yaml
additional_libs_path:
  - app/services
```

engine_paths.markdownDescription:
Engines to include in the scan. Globs are supported.

**CLI:** `--add-engines-path path1,path2`

enable_checks.markdownDescription:
Optional checks to enable in addition to the defaults. Use the full class name, including the `Check` prefix.

**CLI:** `-E, --enable Check1,Check2`

**Example:**
```yaml
enable_checks:
  - CheckUnscopedFind
```

run_checks.markdownDescription:
Only run these checks. Use the full class name, including the `Check` prefix.

**CLI:** `-t, --test Check1,Check2`

**Example:**
```yaml
run_checks:
  - CheckSQL
  - CheckCrossSiteScripting
```

skip_checks.markdownDescription:
Checks to skip. Use the full class name, including the `Check` prefix.

**CLI:** `-x, --except Check1,Check2`

**Example:**
```yaml
skip_checks:
  - CheckDefaultRoutes
```

additional_checks_path.markdownDescription:
Directories containing additional out-of-tree checks.

**Note:** for safety, Brakeman ignores this option in a config file unless it is run with `--allow-check-paths-in-config`.

**CLI:** `--add-checks-path path1,path2`

show_timing.markdownDescription:
Measure the time taken by each scan step.

**CLI:** `--timing`

output_format.markdownDescription:
Report format. Written as a Ruby symbol (`brakeman -C` writes the `:to_` form). Cannot be combined with multiple `output_files`; with `output_files`, the format is chosen from each file's extension instead.

**CLI:** `-f, --format TYPE`

**Example:**
```yaml
output_format: :to_json
```

html_style.markdownDescription:
Path to a CSS file to use for HTML output.

**CLI:** `--css-file CSSFile`

ignore_file.markdownDescription:
Ignore file listing warnings to skip. Manage it with `brakeman -I`.

**CLI:** `-i, --ignore-config IGNOREFILE`

show_ignored.markdownDescription:
Show warnings that are normally ignored by the ignore file, without affecting the exit code.

**CLI:** `--show-ignored`

output_color.markdownDescription:
Use ANSI colors in reports. `true` only colors output to a terminal; `:force` always colors it, even when piped.

**CLI:** `--[no-]color`

**Example:**
```yaml
output_color: :force
```

message_limit.markdownDescription:
Limit message length in the HTML report.

**CLI:** `--message-limit LENGTH`

pager.markdownDescription:
Use a pager for output to a terminal.

**CLI:** `--[no-]pager`

table_width.markdownDescription:
Limit table width in the text report.

**CLI:** `--table-width WIDTH`

output_files.markdownDescription:
Files to write reports to. The format of each is chosen from its extension (`.html`, `.json`, `.sarif`, ...). Defaults to stdout.

**CLI:** `-o, --output FILE`

**Example:**
```yaml
output_files:
  - tmp/brakeman.html
  - tmp/brakeman.json
```

collapse_mass_assignment.markdownDescription:
Report a single warning for all models without `attr_accessible`, instead of one per model.

**CLI:** `--no-separate-models`

summary_only.markdownDescription:
`:summary_only` (or `true`) outputs only the summary of warnings. `:no_summary` outputs the warnings without the summary.

**CLI:** `--[no-]summary`

**Example:**
```yaml
summary_only: :no_summary
```

markdownEnumDescriptions: Only output the summary
Output warnings without the summary

absolute_paths.markdownDescription:
Output absolute file paths in reports.

**CLI:** `--absolute-paths`

github_repo.markdownDescription:
Link to files on GitHub in Markdown and HTML reports. Format is `USER/REPO[/PATH][@REF]`; the ref defaults to `master`.

**CLI:** `--github-repo USER/REPO[/PATH][@REF]`

**Example:**
```yaml
github_repo: yippee-fun/app@main
```

text_fields.markdownDescription:
Fields to include in the text report, in order.

Values must be written as Ruby symbols (with a leading colon), as Brakeman compares them against symbols. Plain strings are silently ignored.

**CLI:** `--text-fields field1,field2`

**Example:**
```yaml
text_fields:
  - :confidence
  - :check
  - :message
  - :file
  - :line
```

markdownEnumDescriptions: High confidence warnings only
High and medium confidence warnings
All warnings, including weak confidence
min_confidence.markdownDescription:
Minimum confidence level of warnings to report.

**Note:** this runs the opposite way to the CLI flag. `-w3` (high only) is stored as `0`, and `-w1` (all warnings) as `2`.

**CLI:** `-w, --confidence-level LEVEL`

**Example:**
```yaml
min_confidence: 1
```
